# Texas Smart Cities Project

> AI-powered platform for urban sustainability, IoT monitoring, and real-time environmental tracking across Texas and the United States.

The Texas Smart Cities Project, hosted at the University of Texas at Austin's Texas Advanced Computing Center (TACC), develops intelligent systems for urban challenges including energy management, water conservation, and fire incident monitoring. The project combines machine learning, IoT sensors, and real-time data visualization to support sustainable city operations and public safety.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence

## Core Platform & Overview

- [Smart Cities Project Homepage](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/): Texas Smart Cities Project homepage: AI tools for urban sustainability and IoT

## Real-Time Environmental Monitoring

- [Active Fire Incidents Map](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/FireIncident/FireIncidentMap.html): Real-time national fire tracker with air quality monitoring and visualization
- [Active Fire Incidents Map - 3D](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/FireIncident/3D/): 3D fire incidents map with real-time smoke forecasting and air quality data

## Community & Events

- [Smart City Hackathon 2021](https://smartcity.tacc.utexas.edu/pages/hackathon.html): Competition for AI solutions in energy and water sustainability challenges
